name: Kesira Vayn
source_profile: ● Kesira Vayn (CG) is the commander of the Canyon Scouts. Kesira believes the Veyrathi cannot preserve their civilization by hiding indefinitely. She favors cooperation with the other tribes and has quietly shared information about desert passages with Qasari patrols.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 70 (source excerpt; may be partial)
